title: Parthenolide reverses the epithelial to mesenchymal transition process in breast cancer by targeting TGFbeta1: In vitro and in silico studies.
authors: Sufian, Hazera Binte; Santos, Julianna Maria; Khan, Zeina S; Halim, Sobia Ahsan; Khan, Ajmal; Munir, Maliha Tabassum; Zahid, Md Khurshidul; Al-Harrasi, Ahmed; Gollahon, Lauren S; Hussain, Fazle; Rahman, Shaikh Mizanoor
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小白菊内酯通过靶向TGFβ1逆转乳腺癌EMT过程，含分子对接但仅针对蛋白-配体，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: AIMS: Breast cancer metastasis is the leading cause of mortality among breast cancer patients. Epithelial to mesenchymal transition (EMT) is a biological process that plays a fundamental role in facilitating breast cancer metastasis. The present study assessed the efficacy of parthenolide (PTL Tanacetum parthenium) on EMT and its underlying mechanisms in both lowly metastatic, estrogen-receptor positive, MCF-7 cells and highly metastatic, triple-negative MDA-MB-231 cells. MAIN METHODS: MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 cells were treated with PTL (2 muM and 5 muM). Cell viability was determined by MTT (3-(4,5-dimethy lthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyl tetrazolium bromide) assay. Apoptosis was analyzed by the FITC (fluorescein isothiocyanate) annexin V apoptosis detection kit. The monolayer wound scratch assay was employed to evaluate cancer cell migration. Proteins were separated and identified by Western blotting. Gene expression was analyzed by quantitative real-time PCR. KEY FINDINGS: PTL treatment significantly reduced cell viability and migration while inducing apoptosis in both cell lines. Also, PTL treatment reverses the EMT process by decreasing the mesenchymal marker vimentin and increasing the epithelial marker E-cadherin compared to the control treatment. Importantly, PTL downregulates TWIST1 (a transcription factor and regulator of EMT) gene expression, concomitant with the reduction of transforming growth factor beta1 (TGFbeta1) protein and gene expression in both cell lines. Additionally, molecular docking studies suggest that PTL may induce anticancer properties by targeting TGFbeta1 in both breast cancer cell lines. SIGNIFICANCE: Our findings provide insights into the therapeutic potential of PTL to mitigate EMT and breast cancer metastasis. These promising results demand in vivo studies.
abstract_zh: 目的：乳腺癌转移是乳腺癌患者死亡的主要原因。上皮间质转化（EMT）是一种在促进乳腺癌转移中发挥基础作用的生物过程。本研究评估了小白菊内酯（PTL，Tanacetum parthenium）在低转移性、雌激素受体阳性MCF-7细胞和高转移性三阴性MDA-MB-231细胞中对EMT的疗效及其潜在机制。主要方法：用PTL（2 μM和5 μM）处理MCF-7和MDA-MB-231细胞。通过MTT（3-(4,5-二甲基噻唑-2-基)-2,5-二苯基四唑溴化物）测定评估细胞活力。通过FITC（异硫氰酸荧光素）膜联蛋白V凋亡检测试剂盒分析细胞凋亡。采用单层伤口划痕实验评估癌细胞迁移。通过Western blotting分离和鉴定蛋白质。通过定量实时PCR分析基因表达。主要发现：PTL处理显著降低了两种细胞系的细胞活力和迁移，同时诱导细胞凋亡。此外，与对照处理相比，PTL处理通过降低间充质标志物波形蛋白和增加上皮标志物E-钙黏蛋白来逆转EMT过程。重要的是，PTL下调TWIST1（一种转录因子和EMT调节因子）基因表达，同时伴随两种细胞系中转化生长因子β1（TGFβ1）蛋白和基因表达的减少。此外，分子对接研究表明，PTL可能通过靶向TGFβ1在两种乳腺癌细胞系中诱导抗癌特性。意义：我们的发现为PTL缓解EMT和乳腺癌转移的治疗潜力提供了见解。这些有前景的结果需要体内研究来验证。
